environmental_zones.note: loc_lake, loc_fishery, loc_woodland, and other exterior regions now sit over painted full-overworld terrain. Decorative terrain carries no evidence; evidence remains discovery-gated via visual.object_visuals.

notes: The transparent overlay carries no baked case state. Every Case 004 change (missing fountain coping, muddy bootprint, broken glass, moved objects) is a discovery-gated evidence anchor, so baking any of it into an always-on overlay would leak undiscovered clues. Case-specific visual state therefore stays projection- and discovery-gated via visual.object_visuals; the overlay PNG is retained as a reserved layer slot but is not currently composited by the renderer.
